name: pending transfers settle only at acceptance time
input: two accounts, one accepted transfer, and one returned transfer record
test:
ledger = TransferLedger()
ledger.open('ana', 9)
ledger.open('bo', 2)
tx = ledger.create_transfer('ana', 'bo', 5)
assert tx == 'transfer-1'
assert ledger.balance('ana') == 9
assert ledger.transfer(tx) == {'id': 'transfer-1', 'source': 'ana', 'destination': 'bo', 'amount': 5, 'status': 'pending'}
assert ledger.accept(tx) is True
assert ledger.balance('ana') == 4
assert ledger.balance('bo') == 7
record = ledger.transfer(tx)
record['status'] = 'tampered'
assert ledger.transfer(tx)['status'] == 'accepted'

name: insufficient funds reject once and leave balances unchanged
input: a source with four credits and a seven-credit pending transfer
test:
ledger = TransferLedger()
ledger.open('a', 4)
ledger.open('b')
tx = ledger.create_transfer('a', 'b', 7)
assert ledger.accept(tx) is False
assert ledger.balance('a') == 4
assert ledger.balance('b') == 0
assert ledger.transfer(tx)['status'] == 'rejected'
for call in (lambda: ledger.accept(tx), lambda: ledger.cancel(tx)):
    try:
        call()
        raise AssertionError('expected ValueError')
    except ValueError:
        pass

name: merging rewrites pending endpoints and cancels newly self-directed work
input: pending transfers that involve an absorbed account plus an already accepted record
test:
ledger = TransferLedger()
ledger.open('keep', 5)
ledger.open('absorb', 8)
ledger.open('other', 1)
accepted = ledger.create_transfer('absorb', 'other', 2)
assert ledger.accept(accepted) is True
to_other = ledger.create_transfer('absorb', 'other', 3)
from_other = ledger.create_transfer('other', 'absorb', 1)
inside = ledger.create_transfer('keep', 'absorb', 1)
ledger.merge_accounts('keep', 'absorb')
assert ledger.balance('keep') == 11
try:
    ledger.balance('absorb')
    raise AssertionError('expected KeyError')
except KeyError:
    pass
assert ledger.transfer(accepted)['source'] == 'absorb'
assert ledger.transfer(to_other) == {'id': to_other, 'source': 'keep', 'destination': 'other', 'amount': 3, 'status': 'pending'}
assert ledger.transfer(from_other)['destination'] == 'keep'
assert ledger.transfer(inside)['status'] == 'cancelled'
assert ledger.accept(to_other) is True
assert ledger.balance('keep') == 8
assert ledger.balance('other') == 6
